title: ヒシアマ姐さんの責任！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've gotta hurry before lunch ends! Where in the world is that rascal?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, how could I have forgotten to give this lunch to my dorm resident!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She must be hungry… She's always so excited to get the lunches I pack for her too…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Damn, this is no time to just stand around! I gotta get this to her, quick!
Hishi Amazon exhausts herself after scouring the entire academy in order to deliver lunch to the right person.
